sources.title: Island influences on plant functional traits and trait-trait associations across species- and community-scales
sources.design_summary: 37 shared tree species across 35 eastern Chinese islands and 66 nearby mainland plots; 13 carbon-, water-, wood-anatomical, hydraulic, and size-related functional traits
sources.usefulness: Tests whether starting-value-dependent island compression extends beyond floral morphology, while preventing non-floral traits from inflating floral independent-system replication.
sources.next_action: Use only as an external boundary comparison unless a prespecified compatible non-floral synthesis is opened. Do not count its islands, species, or traits as a third floral-morphology system.
sources.claim_boundary: This study is relevant to the broader island-rule response shape but does not provide an independent floral morphology effect compatible with the current Southwest Pacific/Hendriks floral comparison.
